validity.recommendation: No action on existence/classification/Fuel/PipelineType/Owner/endpoints. See the separate spec concern on StartYear1 and the caveat on the P0907 double-count below.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: extensively and independently documented, not a GEM-only entity. The sheet's own cited PNGRB government authorization (https://www.pngrb.gov.in/pdf/ngp/Govt-Authorization/JHDBPL-03022018.pdf, verified live, text confirms 'Jagdishpur-Haldia-Bokaro-Dhamra natural gas pipeline system') and GAIL's own FY2020-21 Integrated Annual Report (p.83/848 mentions JHBDPL by name, verified by direct pdftotext extraction after url_verifier false-negatived on the 17.8MB file) both predate and are independent of each other. Independent trade press across 2019-2026 confirms an active, ongoing build: PM Modi inaugurated the first 585 km Phulpur-Dobhi-Barauni phase on 2019-02-17 (millenniumpost.in, contemporaneous), and CGDIndia (2026-03-27) and PSU Watch (2025-04-09) both describe the still-in-progress remainder. A 2024-05 third-party ERDMP certification audit of the Bihar section (Certification Engineers International Ltd, published by PNGRB 2026-02-09 at https://pngrb.gov.in/pdf/ngp-audit-report/20260209_JHBDPL.pdf) gives valve-station-level chainage detail for real, operating pipe -- about as concrete as evidence gets. CLASSIFICATION: Fuel=Gas and PipelineType=transmission are correct -- PNGRB's own NGPL (natural gas pipeline) common-carrier register carries this exact authorisation, and every independent source describes it as a cross-country transmission trunk, not a gathering/process line. ATTRIBUTION: Owner1=GAIL (India) Ltd 100% is corroborated by every independent source found (CGDIndia, PSU Watch, the ERDMP audit signed by GAIL's own OIC, indianinfrastructure.com's coverage of the Barauni-Guwahati leg) -- no source names a co-owner. StartLocation=Jagdishpur (UP) / EndLocation=Haldia (WB) matches the pipeline's own name and is confirmed independently by offshore-technology.com, PSU Watch and CGDIndia, which all describe the same Jagdishpur(UP)-to-Haldia(WB) route with the Bokaro-Dhamra(Odisha) branch. SPEC (Length/Capacity): LengthKnown=3,546 km and Capacity=23.00 MMSCMD both equal PNGRB's May-2026 NGPL MIS register 'authorised' figures for this exact authorisation (Sr. No. 7, partially-commissioned section: 'Jagdishpur-Haldia-Bokaro Dhamra-Paradip-Barauni-Guwahati', GAIL, authorised 29.01.2018, 3,546 km / 23.0 MMSCMD authorised capacity) -- confirmed by direct pdftotext extraction of the report (url_verifier false-negatives on this 1.2MB PDF; same documented failure mode already recorded in this batch's register-crosswalk staged_resolutions.json, not a new problem). CGDIndia (2026-03-27, genuinely independent of PNGRB) independently corroborates the SAME 3,546 km total as '3,306 km Jagdishpur-Haldia + 240 km Dhamra-Haldia branch' -- so Length clears the 2-independent-source bar at high tier. Capacity is not independently corroborated beyond PNGRB (the origin GEM's India Capacity column already tracks per the crosswalk's own meta note), so it stays medium tier; two GlobalData-network pages (offshore-technology/nsenergybusiness) cite an earlier 16-mmscmd Phase-1 / 32-mmscmd Phase-2-target framing that is a different, older milestone-based description, not a conflict with the 23.0 MMSCMD authorised figure -- noted for the record, not escalated.

validity.recommendation: P0929 itself is the correct row to KEEP -- no change needed here. The duplicate defect is on the OTHER side: P0907 'Barauni-Guwahati Gas Pipeline' (718 km) is very likely a double-counted SECTION of this same system, already flagged and staged for adjudication in P0907's own register-crosswalk shard (batches/india-gas/staging/register-crosswalk/staged_resolutions.json). PNGRB's authorisation name for THIS row's Sr.-No.-7 register entry literally is 'Jagdishpur-Haldia-Bokaro Dhamra-Paradip-Barauni-Guwahati' -- Barauni-Guwahati is embedded in P0929's own authorisation, not a separate one. If that P0907 retirement is accepted, add 'Barauni-Guwahati Pipeline' to P0929's OtherEnglishNames (it already carries 'JHBDPL, Pradhan Mantri Urja Ganga project'). Do not action from this shard alone -- flagging for awareness so the redundancy-cluster adjudication step doesn't miss it via this row.
validity.researcher_notes: Cross-checked the roster: P0929's own current LengthKnown (3,546 km) already equals PNGRB's full authorised length for the combined 'Jagdishpur-Haldia-Bokaro Dhamra-Paradip-Barauni-Guwahati' system -- i.e. P0929's length ALREADY includes the Barauni-Guwahati mileage. If P0907 (718 km) survives as a separate row, India's gas-network total is double-counted by ~718 km. Independent corroboration that Barauni-Guwahati is a section of this same integrated project, not standalone: the 2024-05 ERDMP certification audit (CEIL, published via PNGRB) is literally titled 'GAIL (India) Limited NGPL network of JHBDPL and BGPL, Barauni-Guwahati and its associated facilities of Integrated JHBDPL' and treats the Barauni-Guwahati 24in spur as one operating segment of the same integrated Bihar-region network alongside the Phulpur-Dobhi-Durgapur JHBDPL mainline. Indian Infrastructure's inauguration coverage (2024-03-15) also frames it as part of the Pradhan Mantri Urja Ganga project rather than an independent line. This is consistent with, not a repeat of, the P0907 shard's own finding -- included here only because a reviewer working row-by-row from P0929 would otherwise not see it.

validity.recommendation: Re-examine StartYear1=2025 -- it doesn't match either plausible reading of 'start year' for this phased system. If StartYear1 is meant to record first commercial gas flow anywhere on the line, the true value is 2019 (Phase-1 Phulpur-Dobhi-Barauni section, PM-inaugurated 2019-02-17) or, per the phased-commissioning convention this country already uses elsewhere (Mallavaram-Bhopal-Bhilwara-Vijaipur's P0938/P3602 split), consider whether a separate operating-row split is warranted here too rather than one blended date. If StartYear1 is meant to record the (moving) target full-completion year, the correct current value is 2026, not 2025 -- every source found that discusses a target date (PNGRB register's own 'Dec-25', PSU Watch's 2025-04 'extended to December 2025', and CGDIndia's 2026-03 'revised from March 2026 to September 2026') shows the target has already slipped past 2025 without the line-wide Status ever having been 'operating'. Either reading makes 2025 unsupported by current evidence; flagging to Update rather than guessing which convention applies.
validity.researcher_notes: Traced the target-completion date across time (classic 'commissioning is sectional, not an event' trap for this country): PSU Watch (2025-04-09, independent trade press) reports GAIL had, as of that date, ALREADY revised the completion timeline for the remaining Durgapur-Haldia and Dhamra-Haldia sections from March 2025 to December 2025, citing Right-of-Use clearance delays, with 97.6% of pipe laid and 96.6% commissioned at that point. PNGRB's own May-2026 NGPL MIS register (the sheet's cited source family) still lists this authorisation's target completion as 'Dec-25' with 257 of 3,546 km still under construction as of that report -- i.e. the Dec-2025 target had already lapsed by the time the May-2026 edition was printed. CGDIndia (2026-03-27, independent of PNGRB) reports the timeline has been revised AGAIN, this time to September 2026. So the documented target-date sequence is roughly March-2025 -> Dec-2025 -> (lapsed) -> Sept-2026, a real, repeated slip -- not evidence the line is now fully operating, and not consistent with the sheet's StartYear1=2025 under either a first-gas or a target-completion reading. Separately, first PARTIAL gas is well dated to 2019-02-17 (PM Modi's inauguration of the 585 km Phulpur-Dobhi-Barauni section with Patna/Varanasi spurlines, contemporaneously reported by millenniumpost.in), six years before the sheet's StartYear1. Status itself ('construction') is NOT in question here -- see status_reviews -- only the StartYear1 value.

verifications.note: url_verifier false-negatives on this 7.5MB PDF (same documented large-PDF failure mode as the MIS report elsewhere in this batch); content confirmed live via direct pdftotext -layout extraction, which shows '30" NB' mainline and '24" NB' spur/Barauni-Guwahati chainages by name.

fills.researcher_notes: Diameter was blank on the sheet (a genuine gap per the country guidance -- most India gas rows carry none). This is a mainline trunk with multiple sectional diameters, not one pipe size: offshore-technology.com's market-data page gives 30in for the Phulpur-Bokaro-Kolkata/Bokaro-Ranchi-Angul mainline (1,311 km aggregate), 36in for Angul-Dhamra (206 km), and 24in for Kolkata-Haldia (145 km), with 24in-4in spurlines. The 2024-05 PNGRB ERDMP certification audit of the Bihar section (independent government-commissioned engineering audit, different publisher and origin from offshore-technology/GlobalData) independently corroborates 30in for the Phulpur-Dobhi/Dobhi-Durgapur mainline and 24in for the Dobhi-Silao, Silao-Barauni and Barauni-Guwahati (Bihar section) spur/branch lines -- two independent sources agree on 24in and 30in. The 36in Angul-Dhamra figure rests on offshore-technology.com/nsenergybusiness.com alone (both GlobalData-network sites, so not a second independent source for that one number) -- included in the multi-value field per this repo's documented Diameter convention ('40/42/48'-style lists), but flagging that the 36in leg specifically is single-sourced, unlike 24/30. Excluded the sub-24in spurlines (12in, 6in, 4in) as those describe named spur/tie-in laterals, not the mainline trunk diameter this field is meant to characterize.

verifications.note: url_verifier false-negatives on this large PDF (documented in register-crosswalk staged_resolutions.json); confirmed live via direct pdftotext -layout extraction -- Sr. No. 7 shows 3,289 of 3,546 km operating, 257 km under construction, target Dec-25.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Went to the regulator's register first per the country guidance. PNGRB's May-2026 NGPL MIS report (freshest edition available) files this exact authorisation under PARTIALLY COMMISSIONED, not OPERATIONAL: 3,289 of 3,546 authorised km are operating (92.8%) but 257 km remain under construction, against a target completion of Dec-25 that had already lapsed by the report date. That alone would support keeping Status='construction' (not yet fully in service), but PNGRB is the value's own origin so I went further for genuinely independent, dated confirmation that the line is STILL incomplete: CGDIndia (2026-03-27) reports GAIL revised the completion schedule again, from March 2026 to September 2026 -- i.e. as of last month the project was independently reported as not yet finished. PSU Watch (2025-04-09) gives an earlier snapshot (97.6% laid / 96.6% commissioned, remaining Durgapur-Haldia and Dhamra-Haldia sections pushed from March 2025 to December 2025 on RoU clearance delays) that is consistent with, and predates, both later figures -- the project has been genuinely, continuously 'under construction' rather than complete-but-mis-tagged. Two independent, dated 2025-2026 sources plus the regulator's own current-edition register all agree the pipeline is not fully operating: Status='construction' is current and correct. (The apparent 2024-03 'inauguration' of the Barauni-Guwahati leg, per indianinfrastructure.com, is consistent with a symbolic/partial launch of one branch, not full-system completion -- see the duplicate caveat in validity, and note the still-outstanding 257 km per the May-2026 register appears to sit in the Durgapur-Haldia/Dhamra-Haldia (WB/Odisha) stretch per PSU Watch, not in the already-inaugurated Assam leg.) Separately flagged: StartYear1=2025 does not match this evidence under either a first-gas or target-completion reading -- see the spec concern in validity; that is a value-correction question, not a Status verdict.

summary: P0929 (JHBDPL): existence/classification/attribution/Length/Capacity all independently confirmed (Length now high-tier via CGDIndia corroborating PNGRB); Status='construction' CONFIRMED against the May-2026 PNGRB register (92.8% operating, 257 km still under construction) plus independent 2025-2026 trade press showing the completion target has slipped repeatedly (Mar-2025 -> Dec-2025 -> Sept-2026, still incomplete). Two real findings: StartYear1=2025 is unsupported under either reading (first gas was 2019; the current target is 2026, not 2025) -- flagged spec/concern for Update; and P0929 is one half of the country's known genuine double-count with P0907 Barauni-Guwahati (already staged in the register-crosswalk shard) -- noted here as a caveat since P0929's own authorisation and length already include that section. Diameter deep-filled (24, 30, 36 in, medium tier) since it was blank.
